cheap.title: Cheap
cheap.planningMode: CHEAPGPT cheap. Apply the main prompt; after any compaction or context loss, reread it and run `node .cheapgpt/cheapgpt.mjs status`. Route line first (DIRECT / FOCUSED / FULL); escalate, never downgrade; DIRECT uses no engine. Remove before adding, whole before detail, goal before measure. At every step: status → act → record through the engine → advance; the cards status prints carry the detail; a refusal names the next step; never edit cheapgpt/state.json, log.jsonl or board.md by hand. Plan: goals in the user's words; one-property criteria tagged CORE/NON-CORE, each with its deciding real run and boundary case; `judge: user` for what only the user can judge; Backlog, Drop; frozen before the build. Every phase, loop and the release gate starts with PREVENT: a step back on the whole, then the one-block, the next action written whole. Build: tiny loops until every item is established: PREVENT → dynamic and mechanical builders in parallel on disjoint paths → merge (you write only the seam) → real run → review (yours on FOCUSED, a fresh read-only reviewer on FULL) → outcome. Settle every NOT_MET with a run the engine makes; only reproduced violations block. Every step back: the whole before the detail, removal first, the real property not a look-alike, one correction for the whole property. The engine computes the outcome and the level: tiny → full (a fresh loop-breaker; it builds alone) → re-plan (with the user, who approves before anything is built). One release gate: end to end on the reviewed commit, a fresh review of every item. Checks only per LAW 2, as lean as possible. Watch for a spiral and a virtuous cycle. Native Agent tool with explicit models, never a fork, never poll across turns; never simulate a child or read a missing result as a pass. Send `report` after every review and `report --final` first at ACCEPT.
